title: One folded reading of log variance
description: Published by statespace on every bar it folds, which is why statespace.signals exists as well: 200-odd armed feed-intervals at 1m is twelve thousand messages an hour and no consumer can tell which mattered. Recorded by trading, never consulted - a second volatility-based size cut on top of stops that already scale with volatility was sized on reversion rather than on risk.

log_variance.description: The space the members were fitted in.

spread.description: The predictive spread, in log-variance units.

spread_rule.description: How spread was combined. A recorded spread is not comparable across rules.

spread_saturated.description: Whether the loop that scaled the spread ran out of room. The condition that was silent: a matching loop against its clamp keeps returning numbers, so every member can run out of process noise without one line being out of the ordinary.

fair_variance.description: Present only when the anchor has one. A fair VOLATILITY, not a fair price.

stretch.description: Half-band units, so comparable across feeds.

band.description: The 0.90 interval, present only when the readout has one. source says whether the coverage is measured or assumed, so a consumer can refuse an assumed band without knowing how the choice is made.
